decisions.collectorChecklist: Full 600-card base and full 600-card Tiffany collector sets stay intact, with twelve distinct insert/game checklists. All 1333 resolved cards are explicitly present in CSV, not an untested generator or derived count.
decisions.rookies: 18 base RCs confirmed by canonical TCDB and its separate rookie index. BCP omits four of those and marks #120 Clint Sodowsky RC, unlike TCDB and Keyman. Leave #120 without an RC suffix and flag its disputed designation for review; do not claim the absence of a source tag proves it is not a rookie. Tiffany is a parallel and receives no inferred true-RC suffix. Rookie Sensations/Prospects/Legends titles alone do not confer RC status.
decisions.parallel: Verified Tiffany: glossy coating and silver holographic foil, not matte silver-foil printing variants, glossy non-holographic Team Sets, or isolated gold-foil printing variants. Exclude documented Tiffany #267B Roberto Alomar Gold Foil as a manufacturing variation; retain one canonical Tiffany card per printed number 1-600. No invented complete gold/silver variants.
decisions.scope: Include base, genuine full Tiffany, eleven regular insert families and Thanks a Million physical game card. Exclude separate Update, nine Team Sets, promotional P20 Cal Ripken, and unverified printing-error parallel checklists. No pack-issued autograph family established.
decisions.pack: Default to documented Hobby configuration: 11 trading cards plus the separate Thanks a Million token = 12 total VCS items, 36 packs/box. Tiffany and game-card have odds 1, so two guaranteed non-base pulls leave ten trading/base slots before other insert replacements. Physical nine-base/one-Tiffany/one-insert collation is not guaranteed by independent family rolls; pack/release QA pending.
decisions.channels: Team Leaders 1:9 Hobby enabled. Lumber Company is 1:9 Retail only and remains null under the Hobby default; checklist still staged for pricing/images. No unverified market-share normalization. Admin may choose a different channel model before release.
decisions.game: Preserve the single documented physical Thanks a Million game card. Do not fabricate six separate scratch-letter cards or implement prize payouts, real-money games or automated redemption.
decisions.teamData: All player teams populated from verified source rows. Only the generic NNO game card has no franchise; leave blank, review.teamData PENDING and use --allow-pending-teams when staging. No invented MLB team.
decisions.release: Unreleased draft only. Pricing, card/pack art, pack-collation/channel QA and the explicitly disputed #120 RC designation require Admin review.
